path.description: Absolute path on the target daemon's file system of the file, directory, or supported image to read, or a complete `kkstudio:` resource/skill URI. Relative paths are rejected; use a drive-rooted or UNC path such as `C:/src/app.ts` on Windows targets.

offset.description: Positive integer 1-based line offset for text reads. Defaults to 1. An offset past the last line is an empty range, not an error.

limit.description: Positive integer maximum number of text lines to return. Defaults to 2000 and must not exceed 2000. The returned body is additionally bounded to 60000 Unicode code points.

column_offset.description: Optional positive integer 1-based offset in Unicode code points within the first returned line. Text files only; it does not constrain limit and does not apply to later lines.
